Source.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/6] The Child Behaviour Checklist (CBCL [1]; Dutch revision by Verhulst, Koot, Akkerhuis & Veerman [55]) is a 118-item scale assessing an array of behavioural problems and social competencies.

MedCat.evidence_source: [/page/2/Text/6] A T-score ≥ 63 on the Internalising subscale and the subscale Anxious/Depressed was used as the cut-off score.
